title: I made this football game with AI in ~3 hours — Paper Soccer (free in the browser)
author: DanaGamesStudio
selftext:
I made this football game with AI in \~3 hours and I want people to actually play it, not just watch a trailer.

Paper Soccer is a free browser game (no signup). It's paper-style football on a 3D pitch: you take turns shooting, you can play online 1v1 or vs AI, and there are cups, leagues, kits and a career.

I used AI to help with the code, the art direction and the 3D characters (Phaser 3, TypeScript and three.js). What worked: getting a full playable loop, menu, shop and match up very fast. What didn't: the first characters looked cheap and blocky, and I had to throw that approach away and rebuild them as proper players. Touch layout on real phones also took more care than the first pass suggested.

I'd love blunt feedback: is a match fun in the first minute? Does it feel good on a phone? Anything that feels off?
